en: Vintage printed postcard with three black‑and‑white illustrations. On the left is a large brick building labeled "Hotel Keizer Karel" with a central tower and flag. In the upper center-right, framed by floral motifs, is a gabled historic building labeled "De Waag." On the far right is a garden scene with an arched stone structure labeled "De Ruïne." At the top center is a purple stamped word "VOORHEEN" with arrows on both sides. At the bottom right is the greeting text "Groeten uit Nijmegen." The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century souvenir postcard from the Dutch city of Nijmegen.
